info.title: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
info.synopsis: Ken'ichi, un uomo single di quarant'anni, viene trasportato in un altro mondo senza alcun apparente motivo. Mentre prova a fuggire da una foresta pericolosa, si rende conto di avere acquisito il potere di accedere a un enorme negozio online. Usando questo potere per scambiare i beni trovati in questo mondo con denaro contante da usare per comprare ciò di cui ha bisogno, riesce in breve tempo a creare un vero e proprio giro d'affari. Tuttavia, Ken'ichi sogna di vivere una vita tranquilla, quindi, anziché far crescere ulteriormente i suoi affari, decide di mettere radici e vivere del suo potere.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Kenichi, a single man close to 40, suddenly finds himself standing in the woods of another world. After realizing his Skill lets him use the major online retailer "Shangri-La" from his original world, he exchanges items from this new world for money and purchases various products to survive outdoors. However, his life is soon thrown in peril as he finds himself surrounded by monsters.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Kenichi is steadily increasing his sales when Myaley and other beastfolk are lured into him by the smell of spices. He refuses to sell spices to them so he can stay off the radar of the spice syndicates, but he gives into pressure from the beastfolk and offers an alternative. Primula, the first daughter of the Mallow Trading Company appears before Kenichi.
